title: Mohéli merchants’ gathering against port taxation
location: Place de l’Indépendance, Fomboni, Mohéli; merchants later regrouped at the chamber of commerce; dispute concerned Bangoma port.
scope: Local action in Mohéli; no multi-island/national coordination established.
organizer: Mohéli private-sector merchants/operators; source also names the Union des opérateurs économiques, but does not identify a formal convener for the gathering.
threshold_50_evidence: Source reports an actual gathering that was dispersed and says most merchants regrouped, plus a morning closure of shops across Mohéli. It publishes no count of persons simultaneously at the gathering. Shop closures cannot be converted into protest attendance; >=50 remains unestablished.

start_date.summary: The issue dates the gathering and strike activity to Monday 28 Oct 2024.

end_date.summary: The Oct issue says activity resumed on 29 Oct; the Nov issue describes an end to an indefinite strike on Nov 1. Whether these reports mark the same action and its end is unresolved, so no end date is assigned.

location.summary: Place de l’Indépendance and chamber of commerce in Mohéli/Fomboni; tax dispute at Bangoma port.

organizer.summary: The newspaper attributes the planned gathering to the private sector in Mohéli and identifies merchants/operators; a formal convenor is not specified.

demands.summary: Opposition to SCP’s contested per-article container tax at Bangoma.

participants_original.summary: No count of gathering participants is published; closures across the island refer to shops, not persons at the gathering.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: An actual gathering and later regrouping are reported, but no simultaneous headcount or credible qualitative estimate establishes 50.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence is described; absence from this partial report is not a no-violence finding.

state_response.summary: The report says security forces dispersed the gathering and the island governor urged resumption while continuing negotiations. It does not report arrests, beatings, shootings or killings.

state_target.summary: Demand concerned taxation imposed by Société comorienne des ports, with the governor negotiating, but the source does not establish SCP’s state ownership/status or whether the tax was state policy.

notes: The public gathering and dispersal are documented. Threshold is not established: island-wide shop closure is not a simultaneous crowd count. The target is a Comorian port company tax; whether this constitutes a demand on own-state policy is also unresolved. Keep the Nov 1 report as a possible continuation, not a second confirmed event. Country code was not supplied in the assignment and remains null.
open_questions: Was the gathering at Place de l’Indépendance at least 50 people simultaneously?
Was SCP a state authority/enterprise for purposes of own-state policy coding, and was the demand explicitly directed to the Comorian government?
Was the Nov 1 few-hour strike a resumption/continuation after the Oct 29 pause, or a separate action?
What was the physical end date of the gathering/strike?
